<issue>
--failed performs retry for passed tests with --max-retry-count flag
When max-retry-count is enabled and after that a gauge run --failed is performed, specs that passed with --max-retry-count will be executed anyway as if they failed.

**To Reproduce**
1. Perform an execution with max-retry-count=2
2. Some tests will pass after 1 retry
3. Perform gauge run --failed
4. Failed tests and those who passed with max-retry-count=2 will execute

**Expected behavior**
I would expect that only tests that completely failed would be triggered by --failed


Your Environment Information -----------
	linux, 1.4.1, a82478a
	html-report (4.1.2), java (0.7.9), json-report (0.3.1), spectacle (0.1.4), xml-report (0.2.3)


</issue>

The repository is at /testbed.

input.instruction: In /testbed (Go project gauge), find where retries (max-retry-count) are implemented in execution code and where failed scenarios/specs are recorded for `--failed` (e.g. failed.json / rerun / result.GetFailed / writeFailedMeta). Report relevant code snippets with file paths and line numbers, especially how the failed state is accumulated across retries.

content.content: {"summary":"Retries are implemented as a per-scenario loop in execution/specExecutor.go. Failed items for `--failed` are recorded by event listeners in execution/rerun/rerun.go and written to .gauge/failures.json. Failures are accumulated in a map keyed by spec file, so a failure from any attempt stays recorded even if a later retry passes. The flag is actually named `max-retries-count` (plural), not `max-retry-count`.","findings":["cmd/run.go:63 defines the flag name `max-retries-count`; cmd/run.go:134 registers it with default 1 (`maxRetriesCountDefault`, line 45). cmd/run.go:294 rejects `--retry-only` unless the count is >1. cmd/cmd.go:162-163 copies the values into execution.MaxRetriesCount and execution.RetryOnlyTags.","execution/execute.go:61-64 declares the globals MaxRetriesCount and RetryOnlyTags; execution/execute.go:212 rejects values below 1.","execution/specExecutor.go:293-305: shouldRetry is false when RetryOnlyTags is set and the scenario's tags do not match it.","execution/specExecutor.go:307-337 is the retry loop: `for i := 0; i < MaxRetriesCount; i++`. Each attempt builds a fresh ScenarioResult (line 319-324) and calls e.scenarioExecutor.execute (line 328). The loop breaks at line 333-335 when `!shouldRetry || !scenarioResult.GetFailed()`. Line 337 stores RetriesCount on the final result.","execution/specExecutor.go:312-315 exposes the attempt to execution info via ScenarioRetriesInfo{MaxRetries: MaxRetriesCount-1, CurrentRetry: retriesCount}.","execution/scenarioExecutor.go:63 and :66-67 publish event.ScenarioEnd for every attempt (deferred), so the rerun listener sees each failed attempt, not only the final one.","execution/rerun/rerun.go:32-36 holds the global `failedMeta`; :38-42 defines failedMetadata {Args, failedItemsMap map[spec]map[item]bool, FailedItems}.","execution/rerun/rerun.go:74-97 ListenFailedScenarios subscribes to ScenarioEnd, SpecEnd and SuiteEnd. ScenarioEnd calls prepareScenarioFailedMetadata; SpecEnd calls addFailedMetadata(addSpecFailedMetadata); SuiteEnd calls addFailedMetadata(addSuiteFailedMetadata), then aggregateFailedItems(), then writeFailedMeta(getJSON(failedMeta)) at line 92.","execution/rerun/rerun.go:99-105 prepareScenarioFailedMetadata: if res.GetFailed(), it adds the item `relpath:startLine` under the spec file key via addFailedItem. Because the map is a set, a repeated failure of the same scenario across retries is deduplicated, and earlier failures are not cleared by a later pass.","execution/rerun/rerun.go:107-111 addSpecFailedMetadata deletes the spec's entry from failedItemsMap, then re-adds the spec file as a whole item. This runs only when the spec has pre/post hook failures (addFailedMetadata at :124-128), which replaces per-scenario entries with the spec-level entry.","execution/rerun/rerun.go:113-122 addSuiteFailedMetadata resets the whole failedItemsMap and re-adds the args passed on the command line. It runs only for suite-level hook failures, per the same check at :124-128.","execution/rerun/rerun.go:58-60 aggregateFailedItems flattens the map into FailedItems; :48-56 getFailedItems iterates the map, so output order is nondeterministic.","execution/rerun/rerun.go:130-140 writeFailedMeta writes <ProjectRoot>/.gauge/failures.json (constant failedFile at :28). getJSON at :142-148 marshals it with indentation.","execution/rerun/rerun.go:150-157 GetLastFailedState reads the file and returns meta.args() (Args + FailedItems), or errors with 'No failed tests found.' when FailedItems is empty. cmd/run.go:161-167 calls it from executeFailed. rerun.go:159-172 SaveState collects the original command args minus spec paths, and readLastFailedState is at :174+."],"confidence":0.8}
